$comment: Gaps between the high-level metamodel specification (docs/architecture-metamodel-high-level-spec.md, frozen) and the implementation, recorded 2026-10-25. Status changes only on the owner's decision. Rendered into docs/architecture-metamodel-detail-level-spec.md.

gaps.high_level_says: Within-level relationships are out of scope; nothing in SDEM reads or validates them.
gaps.implemented: 132 within-level rows, stored in metamodel/level-relationships.json and enforced by sdem-graph check (built at the owner's later request).
gaps.status: decided 2026-10-25 (owner): recorded in the detail spec; the high-level spec is not changed — detail §6.1 supersedes high-level §6.1

gaps.high_level_says: No entity may claim canonical-standard status without a release-specific verification record; evidence_status is computed from the register.
gaps.implemented: 21 ArchiMate-derived entities carry evidence_status confirmed_in_official_source, set by hand at v0.4.0 on the strength of the open-source Archi relationship tables; no verification record exists.
gaps.recommendation: Set them to interpreted_from_official_source until a register entry exists.

gaps.implemented: alignment_kind = related; composite is not one of the values §3 allows.
A4 is named "Technology" in records, files (a4-technology.json), documents and diagrams.

gaps.high_level_says: Optional reference fields source_system and source_entity_id; optional document pin profile_id.
gaps.implemented: None of the three is in schema/relationship-registry.schema.json (metamodel_version is).
gaps.recommendation: Add the three as optional fields.

gaps.high_level_says: resolve_entity(ref) returns a ResolvedEntity (id, type, version, source_system, lifecycle_status, attributes); a missing lookup yields unverified.
gaps.implemented: The v0.2.1 form resolve_entity(id, type, version) returning the instance (sdem/graph.py, sdem/reference.py).

gaps.high_level_says: Derived relationships are queries over stored edges, never records.
gaps.implemented: The inference engine writes derived-path rows (S07, S15, S16, S40–S54) as candidate reports in a candidates file — never registry records, but stored output.
gaps.recommendation: Allow candidate reports (never registry records) and say so.

gaps.high_level_says: Bank Architecture Profiles (example-bank, example-cloud), where / include / exclude rules, profile validation; cloud types moved to the example-cloud profile.
gaps.implemented: No profiles/ directory; profile validation stage absent; the example-cloud types exist nowhere.

gaps.high_level_says: BIAN verification register; evidence_status computed from it at load time, never hand-edited.
gaps.implemented: No metamodel/verification/; evidence_status is set in the records.

gaps.high_level_says: canonical_id valid in the stated release (pass / fail / unverified).
gaps.implemented: Always unverified: only Null and Static reference resolvers exist; a licensed resolver is institution-side.
gaps.recommendation: None — matches the design until a licensed resolver exists.

gaps.implemented: Architecture Relationship Rules Model: 69 plan rows, fill steps, join keys (metamodel/relationship-rules.json, export-conventions.json).
gaps.status: decided 2026-10-25 (owner): recorded in the detail spec; the high-level spec is not changed

gaps.implemented: Data model: core, common, entity-specific and derived attributes; logical rules LC-01…LC-13; per-entity JSON Schemas.
gaps.status: decided 2026-10-25 (owner): recorded in the detail spec; the high-level spec is not changed

gaps.implemented: Source reference, reasoning and confidence on every record under one confidence rule; natural-key identifiers on entities.
gaps.status: decided 2026-10-25 (owner): recorded in the detail spec; the high-level spec is not changed

gaps.high_level_says: Not covered (§11 lists AI-assisted proposals as a later release).
gaps.implemented: The rule-based inference engine, decisions DEC-E-01…09 and the acceptance harness.
gaps.status: decided 2026-10-25 (owner): recorded in the detail spec; the high-level spec is not changed

gaps.high_level_says: §1: v0.4 does not implement a persistent federated graph.
gaps.implemented: The local JSON graph store (JSON Graph Format v2) with load record, baselines and queries.
gaps.status: decided 2026-10-25 (owner): recorded in the detail spec; the high-level spec is not changed
